title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Treatment in Lagos
description: Rheumatoid arthritis is an autoimmune condition that can cause joint pain, swelling, stiffness, fatigue, and progressive joint damage if not managed early.
seoTitle: Rheumatoid Arthritis Treatment in Lagos | Dr Olaosebikan
seoDescription: Get expert evaluation and treatment for rheumatoid arthritis in Lagos. Learn symptoms, diagnosis, and care options with Dr Olaosebikan.

sections.heading: What is rheumatoid arthritis?
body: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic inflammatory disease in which the immune system mistakenly attacks the joints.
It commonly affects the hands, wrists, feet, and other joints, and may interfere with movement, comfort, grip strength, and daily activities.

cards.title: Morning stiffness
cards.description: Stiffness that lasts for a prolonged period after waking can be an important clue.

cards.title: Swollen or painful joints
cards.description: Joints may feel warm, tender, swollen, or painful, especially during flare-ups.

cards.title: Pain in multiple joints
cards.description: Symptoms often affect more than one joint and may involve the hands, wrists, feet, or knees.

cards.title: Fatigue and reduced energy
cards.description: Some people feel unusually tired or limited in daily activity because of inflammation.

sections.heading: How diagnosis is made
body: Diagnosis depends on a detailed clinical assessment, including symptoms, physical examination, medical history, and review of investigations where relevant.
Early diagnosis is valuable because timely treatment can help reduce inflammation and protect joint function.

sections.heading: Treatment approach
body: Treatment plans are tailored to the individual and may include patient education, medicines to control inflammation, symptom relief, disease monitoring, and ongoing follow-up.
The aim is to improve comfort, reduce disease activity, preserve joint function, and support quality of life over time.

sections.heading: When to book
body: Consider booking if you have persistent joint swelling, prolonged morning stiffness, pain affecting multiple joints, or an existing rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis that needs specialist review.

title: Gout Treatment in Lagos
description: Gout is a painful form of inflammatory arthritis that can cause sudden attacks of swelling, redness, heat, and severe joint discomfort.
seoTitle: Gout Treatment in Lagos | Dr Olaosebikan
seoDescription: Learn about gout symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment in Lagos with specialist care from Dr Olaosebikan.

sections.heading: What is gout?
body: Gout is a form of inflammatory arthritis linked to uric acid crystal deposits in the joints.
It often affects one joint at a time, especially the big toe, but may also affect the ankles, knees, feet, wrists, elbows, or other joints.

cards.title: Sudden severe joint pain
cards.description: Pain may begin suddenly and can be intense, especially during an acute flare.

cards.title: Redness and swelling
cards.description: The affected joint may become swollen, red, and visibly inflamed.

cards.title: Warmth and tenderness
cards.description: The joint may feel hot, tender, and painful even to light touch.

cards.title: Repeated attacks over time
cards.description: Some people experience recurrent flare-ups that require long-term prevention planning.

sections.heading: How diagnosis is made
body: Diagnosis is based on the pattern of symptoms, medical history, examination, and supporting investigations where necessary.
Specialist review helps separate gout from other causes of joint pain, swelling, and inflammatory arthritis.

sections.heading: Treatment approach
body: Treatment may involve relief of acute flare-ups, prevention of future attacks, identification of contributing factors, and long-term strategies for recurrent gout.
The goal is to reduce pain, control inflammation, and help prevent repeat episodes.

sections.heading: When to book
body: Book an appointment if you have sudden attacks of severe joint pain, repeated swelling episodes, pain that keeps returning, or an existing gout diagnosis that needs specialist review.

title: Lupus Care in Lagos
description: Lupus is a complex autoimmune condition that can affect different parts of the body, including the joints, skin, blood, kidneys, and other organs.
seoTitle: Lupus Care in Lagos | Dr Olaosebikan
seoDescription: Specialist lupus care in Lagos. Understand symptoms, diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment options with Dr Olaosebikan.

sections.heading: What is lupus?
body: Lupus is an autoimmune disease in which the immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own tissues.
Because it can affect different organs and body systems, symptoms may vary widely from one person to another.

cards.title: Joint pain or swelling
cards.description: Lupus may cause aching, swelling, or stiffness in the joints, sometimes with flare-ups.

cards.title: Fatigue
cards.description: Many people with lupus experience persistent tiredness that affects daily activities.

cards.title: Skin rashes
cards.description: Rashes may occur, especially in people whose lupus affects the skin.

cards.title: Fever or unexplained illness
cards.description: Some patients report episodes of feeling unwell, with symptoms that come and go.

sections.heading: How diagnosis is made
body: Diagnosing lupus usually involves detailed clinical assessment because symptoms may overlap with other conditions.
A specialist approach is important because lupus can present in different ways and may require long-term monitoring.

sections.heading: Treatment approach
body: Treatment focuses on controlling disease activity, reducing inflammation, protecting organ health, monitoring flare-ups, and supporting long-term wellbeing.
Care plans depend on the organs involved, symptom severity, and the patient's overall health needs.

sections.heading: When to book
body: Book an appointment if you have symptoms suggestive of autoimmune disease, a previous lupus diagnosis, recurrent joint pain, unexplained fatigue, skin symptoms, or other concerns that need specialist follow-up.

body: This page is for people with persistent joint pain, swelling, stiffness, reduced range of movement, or symptoms that may be linked to arthritis, inflammation, gout, autoimmune disease, or other musculoskeletal conditions.
A focused specialist assessment can help clarify whether the problem is inflammatory, mechanical, or related to a longer-term condition.

cards.title: Pain in one or more joints

cards.title: Morning stiffness

cards.title: Swelling, redness, or warmth
cards.description: Some causes of joint pain lead to visible swelling or inflammation in the affected joint.

cards.title: Reduced movement or daily function
cards.description: Symptoms may affect walking, gripping, climbing stairs, or completing normal daily tasks.

sections.heading: How diagnosis is made
body: Diagnosis begins with careful review of symptoms and physical examination.
The pattern, duration, severity, and distribution of symptoms often help distinguish between inflammatory and non-inflammatory causes of joint pain.

sections.heading: Treatment approach

The overall aim is to improve comfort, preserve movement, and support better daily function.

title: Autoimmune Disease Specialist in Lagos
description: Autoimmune diseases can present in many ways, including joint pain, fatigue, rashes, swelling, and symptoms affecting different parts of the body.
seoTitle: Autoimmune Disease Specialist in Lagos | Dr Olaosebikan
seoDescription: Consult an autoimmune disease specialist in Lagos for expert diagnosis, monitoring, and long-term care.

sections.heading: What are autoimmune diseases?
body: Autoimmune diseases develop when the immune system mistakenly attacks the body's own tissues.
These conditions may affect the joints, skin, muscles, blood vessels, or internal organs, and symptoms can vary widely from one person to another.

cards.title: Persistent fatigue
cards.description: Ongoing tiredness or reduced energy can be part of autoimmune disease activity.

cards.title: Joint pain and swelling
cards.description: Inflammation may affect the joints and lead to pain, swelling, and stiffness.

cards.title: Muscle aches
cards.description: Some people experience widespread muscle discomfort or soreness alongside other symptoms.

cards.title: Unexplained rashes or multi-system symptoms
cards.description: Autoimmune diseases may affect the skin and other body systems at the same time.

sections.heading: How diagnosis is made
body: Diagnosis often involves medical history, symptom pattern, physical examination, and review of relevant tests.
Because autoimmune diseases can mimic other illnesses, specialist assessment helps narrow the diagnosis and identify the most likely cause of ongoing symptoms.

sections.heading: Treatment approach
body: Management focuses on controlling inflammation, reducing flare-ups, monitoring organ involvement where necessary, and improving quality of life.
Treatment plans are tailored to the type of disease, disease activity, symptom burden, and the patient's individual health needs.

sections.heading: When to book
body: Book an appointment if you have symptoms suggestive of autoimmune disease, recurrent unexplained inflammation, joint pain with fatigue or rash, or an existing diagnosis that needs ongoing specialist review.
